info.title: DabApp Marketplace API
info.description:
Storefront API of the parts & accessories marketplace, for the mobile app and the web.

## Before you call anything

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Base path | `/api/marketplace/...` (same host as the rest of the DabApp API) |
| Header on **every** call | `Accept: application/json` |
| Logged-in calls | `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>` (the same token as the rest of the app). In this page click **Authorize** once and paste the token. |
| Uploads (logo, cover...) | `multipart/form-data`. A file field is sent as a file part, not as base64. |
| Files | Every `*_url` is an absolute URL, or `null` when there is no file. |
| Languages | Names come as `name` and `name_ar`. The app picks the one that matches the user's language. |

## Who can call what

| Level | Token | A guest gets |
|---|---|---|
| **Public** | not needed | the data |
| **User** | required | `401` with `requires_auth: true` |

A guest hitting a *User* endpoint gets exactly this. Open your login screen, then repeat the call:

```json
{ "success": false, "error": "Unauthenticated", "message": "You must be authenticated to access this resource.", "requires_auth": true, "action": "login" }
```

## Response shapes

| Case | Status | Body |
|---|---|---|
| Read | 200 | `{ "data": ... }` |
| Write | 200 / 201 | `{ "message": "...", "data": ... }` |
| List | 200 | `{ "data": [...], "meta": { "current_page", "per_page", "last_page", "total" } }`. Ask with `?page=1&per_page=15` (max 50). |
| Not found | 404 | `{ "message": "..." }` |
| Refused | 403 / 409 | `{ "message": "...", "code": "SOME_CODE" }`. **Use `code` in your logic, show `message` to the user.** |
| Invalid input | 422 | `{ "errors": { "field": ["message"] } }`. Show each message under its field. |

## Flows worth knowing

- **Browse**: categories, brands, shops. No login.
- **Become a seller**: `POST /vendor/apply`, then poll `GET /vendor/me` and use its `status` to pick the screen: `pending`, `rejected` (show `status_reason`, let the user resubmit), `suspended`, `active`.

delete.description: Soft delete. If it was the default, the most recently added remaining address becomes the new default.

get.description: Active brands with their number of visible products. With category_id (sub-categories included) only brands that have products there are returned. Access: Public.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only brands with products in this category or its descendants

200.description: Brands, featured first then A-Z. products_count counts visible products (with category_id: only those inside that category).

empty.summary: Nothing matches (search=zzz): an empty list, never a 404

get.description: Empty cart shape (items: []) when nothing was ever added - never a 404. Access: Public (guest via X-Cart-Session) or User.

parameters.name: X-Cart-Session
parameters.description: Guest only, ignored for a logged-in user

delete.description: Removes every item, keeps the cart itself (empty cart shape afterwards, never 404).

post.summary: Add an item to the cart
post.description: variant_id is required when the product has variants (color/size...), refused otherwise (422) - check has_variants on the product first. Adding a product/variant already in the cart increases its quantity instead of creating a second line. Access: Public (guest via X-Cart-Session) or User.

parameters.name: X-Cart-Session
parameters.description: Required for a guest (no Bearer token) - any client-generated string

variant_id.description: Required when the product has variants

404.description: No cart, or not this cart's item

delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart

404.description: No cart, or not this cart's item

post.summary: Merge a guest cart into my account on login
post.description: Call this once right after login, passing the X-Cart-Session value the app was using as a guest. Matching product/variant lines are added together (capped to available stock); the rest are moved over. The guest cart is marked converted and emptied. Safe to call with no guest cart to merge - just returns your account cart. Access: User.

get.description: Without parent_id: top-level categories. With parent_id: its direct children. With tree=1 every level is nested under 'children'. Only active categories. Access: Public.

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Return the children of this category instead of the top level

200.description: Categories, ordered as the admin arranged them.

tree.summary: tree=1: every level nested under children (leaves have an empty children list)

404.description: parent_id does not exist or is inactive

get.description: Category with its breadcrumb (root to parent) and direct children. Access: Public.

post.summary: Convert my cart into an order and start payment
post.description: Send exactly one shipping_methods entry per vendor present in the cart. idempotency_key: any client-generated string (e.g. a UUID) — resending the same key returns the original order instead of creating a second one, safe to retry on a network error. address_id XOR new_address is required.

promo_codes.description: At most 2: one platform code (DabApp-wide) and one shop code (discounts only that vendor's lines).

409.description: Cart empty or not enough stock

422.description: Validation error, or an invalid/expired/inapplicable promo_codes entry (code=INVALID_PROMO_CODE)

get.description: Everything the home screen needs in one call, in the order the screen shows them: Shops, Accessories (categories), Bike Type, Brand. bike_types and bike_brands come from the app's existing vehicle tables (the same ones the moto listings use), not from the marketplace catalog: 'Bike Brand' means Honda / KTM / Yamaha (who made the bike), never a marketplace parts brand like Michelin. Both are filtered down to only the ones that have at least one compatible product in the marketplace — a brand or type with nothing to sell stays out, so this list is never the full vehicle catalog (500+ brands). Access: Public.

shops.description: Featured shops first, then best rated. View All -> GET /marketplace/vendors.

categories.description: Top-level marketplace categories (the 'Accessories' row on the screen is one example; every root category — Parts, Oils & Care, Accessories, Riding gear — comes back here). View All / tapping one -> GET /marketplace/categories or /marketplace/categories/{id}.

post.description: Resizes to fit inside 1200x800, no watermark (these are catalog/branding assets, not the peer-to-peer listing photos the watermark protects). Returns one absolute URL per file, in the same order. Nothing is attached to any resource yet: pass the URL(s) as a plain string field on the next call (see each resource's endpoint). type=category and type=brand are admin-only (403 ADMIN_ONLY for a regular user). Access: User.

type.description: Picks the storage folder. vendor: shop logo/cover. product: product photos. category/brand: admin only.

images.description: 1 to 10 files, jpg/png/webp, max 8 MB each

403.description: type=category or type=brand from a non-admin token.

example.message: Only admins can upload category images

post.summary: Cancel my order before it ships
post.description: Allowed while the order is pending_payment/paid/processing AND no item has shipped/delivered yet (a multi-vendor order can have one vendor ship before another). Releases reserved stock. Refund (if already paid) is a manual support process, not automated here.

post.summary: Retry payment for a still-unpaid order
post.description: Use when the initial PayTabs payment/request call itself failed (not a declined card) and the order hasn't expired yet.

302.description: Redirects to the frontend order page

get.description: Active products of active vendors only. category_id also matches its sub-categories (Tyres also returns Front tyres / Rear tyres). moto_brand_id / moto_model_id / moto_year_id / bike_type_id match a product's explicit bike-compatibility rows plus universal parts. attributes[Label][]=Value filters on the spec table (e.g. attributes[Grip Style][]=Open Ended) - see GET /marketplace/products/filters for which labels/values exist in a given view. Access: Public.

parameters.name: brand_id
parameters.description: Parts brand (Michelin) - not the bike's manufacturer

parameters.name: bike_type_id
parameters.description: Bike type (Sport, Cruiser, Naked...) - same motorcycle_types table as the Home 'Bike Type' section. Independent of moto_model_id: a vendor can tag a part for a whole type without picking an exact model.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Map of label to one or more values, e.g. attributes[Finish][]=Matte

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default newest. relevance=default, most_recent=newest, lowest_price=price_low, highest_price=price_high (app naming -> API naming)

200.description: Products, newest first by default. Load the next page with page+1 until current_page = last_page.

get.summary: Available filters for a catalog view (facets)
get.description: Call it with the same scoping params as the list (category_id, search, vendor_id, brand_id, moto_brand_id/model_id/year_id, bike_type_id) to get the options worth showing in the Filters sheet for that exact view, each with how many products it would leave. price reflects the real price (the variant range for products that have variants, not the fallback products.price column). Access: Public.

moto_brands.description: The bike's manufacturer (Honda, BMW, KTM) - the Filters sheet's 'Brand' chip. Use with moto_brand_id, not brand_id.

years.description: Bike compatibility years ('Shop By'). Use with moto_year_id.

bike_types.description: Bike type (Sport, Cruiser, Naked...), same table as Home's 'Bike Type' section. Use with bike_type_id.

attributes.description: Map of attribute label to a list of its values with how many products have that value, e.g. Grip Style: Open Ended (12), Close Ended (3)

ratings.description: min-rating buckets with at least one match

get.description: Full gallery, specs (attributes), variants (color/size/...), bike compatibility and the selling shop. Access: Public.

stock_quantity.description: Ignore when has_variants is true - use each variant's own stock

bike_type.description: Sport, Cruiser, Naked... independent of model, may be set even when model is null

data.name: BILT Sprint Gloves
data.description: Aggressive, short cuff glove for warm months.

get.description: Approved reviews only, newest first by default. summary.breakdown is the full count per star (1-5) across every approved review, independent of pagination and sort - build the 'Excellent/Very Good/Good/Fair/Poor' bars from it (5=Excellent ... 1=Poor). Access: Public.

data.title: Great Product!!
data.comment: Better than expected! Works fine and everything is working as great as it should be

post.description: One review per user per product (409 ALREADY_REVIEWED on a second attempt - edit isn't supported yet, delete isn't exposed). Updates the product's rating_avg / reviews_count right away. Photos are URLs from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=product), sent as plain strings in images[]. is_anonymous hides your name from the public list (the API still knows who wrote it). Access: User.

comment.example: Great quality, I liked how fast it was shipped!

tags.description: Freeform, e.g. the app's fixed chip list: Build Quality, Delivery Time, Versatility, Availability, Value For Money, Packaging

get.description: Active carriers only (DHL, Aramex, SMSA, DabApp Shipping...). requires_api_key just flags whether this carrier normally needs its own credentials - vendors don't have to use it. Access: Public.

post.description:
Creates the user's shop with status pending, waiting for admin approval. One shop per user: 409 ALREADY_APPLIED (pending), ALREADY_VENDOR (active) or VENDOR_SUSPENDED. A rejected application can be sent again: it reopens the same shop as pending. Status, slug and commission cannot be set by the user. Access: User.
     *
     * For a logo or a cover, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor) first and send the URL(s) it returns as logo_path / cover_image_path. The city must belong to the country (422 on `city_id` otherwise). Load the pickers from `GET /api/countries-list` and `GET /api/cities?country_id=`.

201.description: Application created. Show the 'under review' screen.

200.description: A rejected application was sent again: same shop (same id), back to pending, reason cleared.

message.example: Application sent again, waiting for approval

example.message: Application sent again, waiting for approval

409.description: The user already has a shop. Use `code`, not the message, to choose the screen.

value.message: Your application is already waiting for approval
You already have a vendor account

get.description: The shop owned by the logged-in user, whatever its status, so the app can show 'under review', 'rejected (with the reason)', 'suspended' or the seller space. 404 NO_VENDOR when the user never applied. Access: User.

200.description: My shop. Pick the screen from `status`: pending = under review, rejected = show `status_reason` and a Resubmit button, suspended = show `status_reason`, active = seller space (`can_sell` is true).

rejected.summary: Rejected: show the reason and a Resubmit button

404.description: The user never applied: show the 'Become a seller' screen.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

put.description: Send only the fields to change. Allowed while pending or active (suspended: 403 VENDOR_SUSPENDED, rejected: use apply to send it again). Send logo_path / cover_image_path: null to remove that image, or omit it to leave it untouched. slug, status and commission are not editable here. Access: User.

logo_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

cover_image_path.description: URL from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image, or null to remove it

200.description: Updated. The response is the whole shop, ready to replace what the app holds.

403.description: The shop is suspended: show the reason, nothing can be edited.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

409.description: The application was rejected: it cannot be edited, send it again with POST /vendor/apply.

example.message: Your application was rejected, apply again to reopen it

get.description: Active vendors only. products_count = active products of the shop. Access: Public.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Default rating (the All Shops 'Top Rated' tab)

200.description: Shops, best rated first by default. Load the next page with page+1 until current_page = last_page.

get.description: Shop header: branding, rating, contact location, categories the shop sells in, and its enabled shipping methods (flat rate). Bank data, commission and carrier keys are never exposed. Access: Public.

data.description: Tyres, brakes and engine parts for sport and touring bikes.

404.description: Unknown shop, or a shop that is not approved (pending, rejected, suspended). Both look the same to the app.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

404.description: No shop, or not your order item

put.summary: Update fulfillment for my order item
put.description: Forward-only: pending -> processing -> shipped -> delivered (or cancelled, blocked once shipped/delivered). Setting shipped/delivered stamps shipped_at/delivered_at. The parent order's own status rolls up once every vendor's lines in it cross the same step.

403.description: Shop not active, or order not paid yet

404.description: No shop, or not your order item

get.description: Every status, own shop only (the storefront's GET /marketplace/products only ever shows active ones). per_page empty = everything, no pagination.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

post.description: reference is the SKU (one product = no variants) - generated from your product name when omitted (uppercased, -2/-3... appended on a collision), same idea as slug. status defaults to active (an approved shop publishes directly) - send draft to hold it back, or pending_review to request an admin look first; inactive/rejected are refused here (422), only an admin sets those. To add photos, call POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=product) first and send the URLs it returns in images[].image_path.

brand_id.description: Parts brand (Michelin), not the bike's manufacturer

reference.description: SKU, unique. Generated from name when omitted.

404.description: No shop, or not your product

put.description: Send only the fields to change. images / attributes / compatibility / variants: send the array to REPLACE the full current set, or omit the key to leave it untouched. status (if sent) accepts draft/pending_review/active - e.g. resubmit a REJECTED product by sending status=pending_review (sending status=active directly on a rejected product is refused, 422: it needs a fresh admin look first), it also clears status_reason. Editing an already-active product's other fields (price, stock...) does not unpublish it: only touch status when you mean to change it.

404.description: No shop, or not your product

422.description: Validation error (also used for status=inactive/rejected, or status=active on a rejected product)

delete.description: Soft delete. Refused with 409 HAS_ORDERS once the product has sold something.

404.description: No shop, or not your product

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

post.description: You can offer a given provider only once. The provider must be active. uses_own_api=true requires credentials (key/value object, e.g. {api_key, account_number}); they are stored encrypted and never returned. Without an own API the flat_rate is used, no carrier call is made (v1).

local_rate.description: Applied instead of flat_rate when the order ships to your own city. Omit/null to always use flat_rate.

example.message: You do not have a vendor account

404.description: No shop, or not your method

put.description: Send only the fields to change. credentials replaces the stored keys when sent; clear_credentials=true removes them. Turning uses_own_api off also wipes the keys. The provider cannot be changed (delete and add another).

local_rate.description: Send null to go back to flat_rate everywhere

404.description: No shop, or not your method

delete.description: Soft delete. Orders already placed keep their shipping snapshot.

404.description: No shop, or not your method

get.description: Products I favorited, newest first. A product that was deleted or went inactive is silently dropped from the list. Access: User.

post.summary: Add a product to my wishlist
post.description: Idempotent: adding a product that is already there just returns it, no duplicate. Access: User.

404.description: Product not found, or not visible

delete.summary: Remove a product from my wishlist
delete.description: Idempotent: removing a product that is not in the wishlist still returns 200. Access: User.

products_count.description: Visible products in this category and all its sub-categories

is_featured.description: Curated by an admin: the Featured badge on All Shops and eligible for the Marketplace home Shops row

MarketplaceMyVendor.description: The owner's view of their own shop (any status).

status_reason.description: Why it was rejected or suspended

can_sell.description: true only when status is active

has_credentials.description: Keys are write-only: only this flag is ever returned

local_rate.description: Applied instead of flat_rate when the order ships to the vendor's own city

MarketplaceOrderItem.description: One product/variant line, frozen at checkout time - name/price/commission never change afterwards even if the product does.

product_name.description: Snapshot - survives the product being edited or deleted

shipping_fee.description: Only non-zero on one line per vendor group - the vendor's flat/local rate, charged once

discount_amount.description: This line's share of every applied promo code (platform + shop combined)

commission_rate.description: % frozen at order time: vendor override > category > global

commission_amount.description: Computed on total_price minus only the shop-funded discount share - a platform-funded discount comes out of DabApp's margin, not the vendor's commission base

vendor_net.description: (total_price - shop-funded discount - commission_amount) + shipping_fee (shipping is never commissioned or discounted)

payout_id.description: Not wired up yet - vendor payouts are a separate future feature

VendorMarketplaceOrderItem.description: Same fields as MarketplaceOrderItem, with the parent order's own status/number and the product/variant names attached - this is what a vendor sees when preparing an item.

cart_id.description: PayTabs-side reference, unrelated to the shopping Cart

payment_url.description: Open in a browser/WebView to complete payment

expires_at.description: Matches the order's own expires_at - the 30-minute reservation window

order_number.description: Sortable, human-readable - show this to the customer, not the numeric id

shipping_address.description: Snapshot taken at checkout - survives the address being edited or deleted afterwards

discount.description: Sum of every applied promo code's discount_amount across all lines (see promo_codes below)

currency.description: Follows the buyer's own checkout-address country (falls back to SAR if unknown), not a fixed value - PayTabs itself still always settles in its own merchant currency underneath

expires_at.description: Pay before this, or the order auto-cancels and stock is released (30 min after creation)

promo_codes.description: One row per applied code (at most one platform + one shop code)

MarketplaceOrderPromoCode.description: One applied promo code, snapshotted at checkout time.

vendor_id.description: null = platform code (DabApp-wide, discounts every line); set = shop code (discounts only that vendor's lines)

discount_amount.description: This code's total effect across every line it applied to

message.example: Your application is already waiting for approval

price.description: The cheapest variant's price when has_variants is true, otherwise the product's own price

price_max.description: Set only when has_variants is true and variant prices differ - show as a 'from-to' range

has_variants.description: true = sold by variant (color/size/...), open the detail for the variants array

brand.description: Parts brand (Michelin), not the bike's manufacturer

image_url.description: Falls back to the product's own cover image when null

VendorMarketplaceProduct.description: List row: a cover thumbnail, no images/attributes/compatibility arrays (see the detail schema). Same shape the admin sees for this same product - nothing here is hidden from its own owner.

price.description: Cheapest variant when has_variants is true, otherwise the product's own price

status.description: Only draft/pending_review are settable from this controller - active/inactive/rejected are admin-only

status_reason.description: Set by the admin when rejecting - clears automatically on your next resubmission

VendorMarketplaceProductDetail.description: Same fields as VendorMarketplaceProduct, with the cover thumbnail replaced by the full images/attributes/compatibility/variants arrays.

id.description: null on the never-touched empty cart shape

product.description: null if the product was removed since this was added

variant.description: null when the product has no variants

unit_price.description: Price when it was added - frozen, compare to current_price

price_changed.description: unit_price != current_price - show a 'price has changed' hint

line_total.description: quantity * unit_price (the frozen price, not current_price)

available.description: false if the product or its shop is no longer active

max_quantity.description: Current available stock for this product/variant

items_count.description: Sum of quantities, not line count

verified_purchase.description: Always false for now - there is no Orders/Cart yet to verify a purchase against

author.description: null when the reviewer chose is_anonymous

Unauthenticated.description: Guest, or the token expired. Open the login screen, then repeat the call.

example.message: You must be authenticated to access this resource.

ValidationFailed.description: Invalid input. Show each message under its field.

city_id: The selected city id is invalid.

tags.name: Marketplace - Addresses
tags.description: A customer's own delivery address book, used at checkout. Access: User (Bearer JWT).

tags.name: Marketplace - Brands
tags.description: Product brands (All Brands screen). Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Cart
tags.description: Works for both guests and logged-in users (mode invité): send a Bearer token to use the account's cart, or an X-Cart-Session header (any client-generated string, e.g. a UUID you keep in local storage) to use a guest cart - never both resolved at once, the token wins if both are sent. A guest who then logs in should call POST /cart/merge once with their old session id to fold it into the account's cart. No stock is reserved by the cart itself - that happens when the order is created (see Checkout); adding to cart only checks that enough stock exists right now.

tags.name: Marketplace - Categories
tags.description: Category tree of the marketplace (unlimited depth). Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Checkout
tags.description: Converts the caller's active cart into one Order (split into one OrderItem group per vendor) and starts a PayTabs payment for it. Stock is decremented immediately (the 'reservation') and released automatically if the order is still unpaid 30 minutes later. Access: User (Bearer JWT) only — a guest must log in first.

tags.name: Marketplace - Home
tags.description: One call for the Marketplace home screen. Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Images
tags.description: Upload images before you use them, the same way listings do it: a standalone endpoint that returns URL strings, decoupled from creating or editing the resource. Send those strings as logo_path / cover_image_path / image_path on the vendor, category, brand or product endpoints — those endpoints take plain JSON, never files.

tags.name: Marketplace - Orders
tags.description: A customer's own orders. Access: User (Bearer JWT).

tags.name: Marketplace - Order payments
tags.description: PayTabs server-to-server webhook and browser return for marketplace orders. Called by PayTabs directly, never by the app — no auth.

tags.name: Marketplace - Products
tags.description: Catalog: list with search/filters, filter facets, product detail. Public, no token needed. Only active products of active vendors are ever visible.

tags.name: Marketplace - Reviews
tags.description: Product reviews: rating, a title/comment, 'what did you like' tags, photos. List is public; writing one needs a token. verified_purchase is always false for now - Orders/Cart (Step 5) aren't built yet, so there is nothing to verify a purchase against.

tags.name: Marketplace - Shipping providers
tags.description: The global carrier list a vendor can pick from when setting up their own shipping methods. Public, no token needed.

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendor account
tags.description: A logged-in user applies to become a vendor and manages their own shop profile. Access: User (Bearer JWT). A guest gets the structured 401 (requires_auth=true). Being a vendor = owning a shop whose status is active; an admin approves applications from the Admin Panel. logo_path / cover_image_path are URLs from POST /api/marketplace/upload-image (type=vendor), not files: upload first, then send the strings here.

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendors
tags.description: Shops (All Shops screen and shop page). Public, no token needed. Only approved (active) vendors are ever visible.

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendor orders
tags.description: A vendor's own order lines, for fulfillment. Only lines belonging to a paid order are visible/editable - a pending_payment order never shows up here. Access: User (Bearer JWT).

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendor products
tags.description: A vendor manages their own catalog from the app. Only an active shop can sell: a pending/rejected/suspended shop gets a structured error instead (same codes as the vendor account endpoints). An already-approved shop is trusted to publish directly: a new product defaults to status=active unless the vendor explicitly asks for draft or pending_review instead (e.g. to prepare it before going live, or to request an extra admin look). An admin can still set inactive/rejected at any time from the Admin Panel (pre- or post-publish moderation). vendor_id and is_featured are never settable here. images / attributes / compatibility / variants follow the same full-replace convention as the admin endpoint: each array sent REPLACES the product's current set. Access: User (Bearer JWT).

tags.name: Marketplace - Vendor shipping methods
tags.description: A vendor sets up their own shipping (carrier + flat rate) from the app, same idea as vendor products. Only an active shop can do this - a pending/rejected/suspended shop gets a structured error instead (same codes as the vendor account/products endpoints). flat_rate is the rest-of-the-country rate; local_rate (optional) applies instead whenever an order ships to the vendor's own city (Vendor.city_id) - a simple 2-tier model, not a full per-city rate table. uses_own_api / credentials exist for a vendor who runs their own carrier API, but have no app UI yet and no real carrier call is ever made (v1, informational only) - leave them out to just use flat_rate/local_rate. Credentials are write-only, encrypted at rest, never returned (only has_credentials). Access: User (Bearer JWT).
